name: Data outlet plan symbol
summary: Plan symbol for a structured-cabling data outlet, usually tagged with the number of ports and outlet ID.
description: Data outlets are drawn as a triangle or a small box tagged D or TO at the wall or floor box position, with the port count as a numeral. Each port is labelled with an ID that matches the patch panel in the communications room.
The plan symbol tells the cabling installer how many cables to pull to each position and supports the cable schedule. It also helps coordinate with power outlets, since desks normally need both.
The symbol does not state cabling category, shielding or connector type. The structured cabling specification covers this.
readingNotes: Match outlet IDs to patch panel labels.
drawingChecklist: Tag outlet ID and port count.
distinction: A telephone outlet is a voice service termination; a data outlet is a structured cabling port for networks.
